field_map.root: CAMEO EventRootCode (col 28) — ingest filter keeps 14/17/18/19/20 roots + 143x strikes
field_map.site: matched tracked-facility id within ~0.5 deg (join key to the Everything Graph)
field_map.rt: as-seen UTC timestamp of the 15-min file

confidence_model: raw geo-tagged event MENTIONS from world media; GDELT geocoding is approximate. CAMEO captures strikes/protests/unrest, NOT clean industrial accidents (FIRMS/AIS are the physical sensors). Burst -> own-sensor confirmation is the gate-2 signal; this archive is the alert-trigger raw material only.
cadence: 15-min poll of lastupdate.txt; identical republished files skipped; CAMEO x facility-bbox filter at ingest keeps the archive KB-scale; dedup by GlobalEventID
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
